18.55.010 “A” definitions.

“Accessory dwelling unit” or ADU means a secondary dwelling on the same zoning lot as a principal dwelling.

Additional text belonging to the same definition.

“Abutting” means sharing a property or district line.

See Chapter 5.135 TMC.
